arathi_barrow_warden: Yelza. I be watchin' de Drowned Barrow for Hammerfall - dat be de mound right behind me, in de north-west of dis shore. It be full of Arathor dead, and dey are still standin' guard in dere. De sea came up into it three years ago and somet'ing came in wit' de water.
arathi_bothy_hermit: I have no name anyone uses now. I was a passenger on a ferry three years ago, when the sea here changed. The ferry ended up on this rock - Bothy Rock, out in the tidal flats east of Saltspur Landing - and I stayed. The pirates on the islands leave me alone. Ask me about them.
